description: Takes an article out of the handbook as its Delete does: it is marked inactive and kept (edit_handbook_article cannot bring it back; a person can). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: archive_handbook_article
title: Remove a handbook article
